item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is learning how breathing works in our body. Air reaches tiny air sacs called alveoli in the lungs, which are surrounded by thin blood vessels.
What happens at the alveoli during gas exchange?

options.A: Carbon dioxide passes from the alveoli into the blood and oxygen passes from the blood into the alveoli
options.B: Oxygen passes from the alveoli into the blood and carbon dioxide passes from the blood into the alveoli
options.C: The alveoli transfer oxygen into the blood only when no blood vessels surround them
options.D: Fresh air flows directly from the alveoli into the blood vessels as a whole
